notes.text: Use revenues less cost of revenues as the economic sales denominator. Gross revenues include liquidity payments, routing/clearing, regulatory fee pass-throughs, and royalty/other costs. Royalty/license fees are an ongoing economic cost and are retained.
notes.locator: Revenue recognition; Components of Revenues and Cost of Revenues; income statement

notes.text: Clearing-member cash and customer deposits have matching current liabilities. The cash-flow statement includes changes in this cash in operating cash flow. These are not corporate cash generation or cash available to equity holders.
notes.locator: Summary of Significant Accounting Policies, cash and cash equivalents; Clearing Operations

notes.text: Section 31 fees payable movements are separately shown. Ex-clearing CFO still includes timing in regulatory fee receivables/payables and other working capital. Subtracting only payable movements is not a fully matched regulatory cash-flow adjustment.
notes.locator: Statements of cash flows; Revenue Recognition

notes.text: Use the full cash purchases line for property/equipment, data-processing software and leasehold improvements, net, without subtracting unrelated asset-sale receipts. No separate upfront license/intangible cash purchase line was disclosed in the extracted statements. Do not assume all future license payments are zero. Additional accrued software purchases of $1.8m at September 30, 2026 are noncash and not deducted a second time.
notes.locator: Statements of cash flows; Commitments, Contingencies and Guarantees

notes.text: License/royalty fees ordinarily vary with contracts traded and remain in costs. Minimum licensing fees excluding variable fees are $14.6m in 2027 for certain agreements expiring through 2033. On September 29, 2026 Cboe announced a 25-year exclusive S&P DJI extension through 2051. No incremental upfront fee is specified in the cited 10-Q discussion.
notes.locator: Commitments, Contingencies and Guarantees; Recent Developments

notes.text: Australia sale closed July 31, 2026 and generated a $71.5m net gain in EBIT, described as non-taxable. Canada sale to TMX remains pending regulatory approvals as of October 30. The combined sale consideration was approximately $300m. Canada held-for-sale assets $169.6m and liabilities $10.5m include $57.4m cash. Do not add the whole $300m again to present cash. Canada tax effects were not reasonably estimable. Businesses do not qualify as discontinued operations and depreciation/amortization ceased on assets classified as held for sale in April 2026.
notes.locator: Acquisitions and Strategic Realignment; Income Taxes

notes.text: Conservative normalized EBIT removes disposal gains, impairments and acquisition contingent-consideration remeasurements but retains acquisition expenses, recurrent technology costs, all SBC including CEO awards, and all acquired-intangible amortization. A separately labeled broader identifiable-exit-cost EBIT also reverses disclosed realignment charges net of impairment overlap and the digital syndication adjustment. CAT note reserve is retained in both base proxies because collection risk is an economic cost; an isolated sensitivity may add it back. No analyst-normalized EPS is invented.
notes.locator: GAAP to non-GAAP reconciliations; FY2025/FY2024 comparable reconciliations

notes.text: 9M2026 cash taxes were $713.7m versus $240.9m in 9M2025; accounts payable/accrual cash outflow was $294.6m. FY2025 filing says some uncertain tax liabilities were reclassified to current accounts payable as payments were possible in the following 12 months. Exact cash tax normalization is not sufficiently disclosed here, so no addback is made.
notes.locator: Statements of cash flows; FY2025 Income Taxes note

notes.text: Gross revenue captions use the FY2025 presentation for all FY2023-25. The regulatory fees cost label replaces Section 31 fees without changing the historical totals used here. Digital ceased being a separate segment in 2025. These changes do not change consolidated net revenue/EBIT scope, but historical segment comparisons and divested-business run rates require separate bridges.

Company adjusted cash is not all surplus capital. Excluding Canada held-for-sale cash, deferred-comp matched assets and minimum regulatory capital gives a conservative proxy, not legally unrestricted distributable cash. Additional operating needs, local approvals and tax costs can reduce available cash.
notes.locator: Financial Assets and Liquidity; Regulatory Capital; Employee Benefit Plans

notes.text: Cash outside the United States was $487.1m including $57.4m held for sale; remaining US cash was $2,232.9m. Certain foreign subsidiary earnings are indefinitely reinvested and related cash is not assumed available for repatriation without a management intent change. The exact amount belonging to those subsidiaries is not separately quantified. Remaining foreign cash excluding Canada is $429.7m, a conservative potential valuation haircut, not a reported restriction on every foreign dollar.

Q3 organic revenue reconciliation excludes Australia net revenue of $20.3m in 9M2026 and $21.5m in 9M2025; standalone FY2025/Q42025 Australia and current Canada P&L were not located in the reviewed SEC statements. Buyer TMX reports combined FY2025 approximate C$87m revenue and C$25m adjusted EBITDA under unaudited IFRS/Australian standards. Those are not a US GAAP standalone net-revenue bridge and have not been inserted into history.
notes.locator: Organic net revenue reconciliation; buyer release https://www.tmx.com/en/newsroom/press-releases?id=1347&year=2026
